subject: Linguistics
title: Why Morphology Matters
description: Learn Why Morphology Matters in one minute.

hook.text: Spell-checkers flag 'ungooglable'—but every English speaker knows exactly what it means.

buildup.text: Morphological knowledge lets you decode unfamiliar words by recognizing their parts.

discovery.text: Language learners who study morphology expand their vocabulary faster than those who memorize lists.

twist.text: Search engines rely on morphological analysis—finding 'run,' 'runs,' 'running' all from one query.

climax.text: From reading to AI, understanding word structure is a core skill across many fields.

punchline.text: Know the parts and new words decode themselves.

quiz.question: Why does morphology help vocabulary growth?
options: Recognizing parts helps decode new words
